acceptance.volume_metric: reported; discrepant solids require Boolean confirmation, except named parts verified by bidirectional surface samples
acceptance.bbox_discrepancy_confirmation: Empty bidirectional Boolean differences establish geometry when computed extrema estimates differ.
acceptance.surface_sample_distance: Explicit source/STEP conversion tolerance in mm; not physical-device accuracy

method: One-to-one source/STEP solid matching by six bounding coordinates; absolute volume errors summed without cancellation; Boolean difference confirmation for discrepant solids. Compound-level volume estimate retained for transparency. Named surface fallbacks check every vertex, seven samples per edge, and trimmed 7x7 UV grids on every face in both directions. Sampling is not an analytical equality proof.
